name: Adobe Firefly
summary: Adobe's generative app. The free plan gives free daily generations across image, video and audio, including partner models. Adobe says output from its own Firefly models is safe for commercial use.

image.models: Firefly models plus partner models (e.g. Nano Banana)
image.allowance: Free daily generations; the number isn't published on the plans page.
image.arena_note: Adobe doesn't say which models the free generations cover.

video.models: Firefly video plus partner models (e.g. Luma Ray)

commercial_note: Adobe: outputs from Adobe Firefly models are safe for commercial use. Partner models have their own terms.
